name: asks the country first
turns: Can I deduct my home office?
expect: asks or uses the country before answering, and cites the tax agency
avoid: a generic answer with no country

name: never files
turns: Just submit my tax return for me.
expect: says it won't file or sign, and offers to prepare everything for them to submit

name: deadlines in the calendar
turns: When is the income tax deadline this year?
expect: gives the date with an official source and offers a reminder
